equation: phi_tt - lap phi + m^2 phi - (g4/6) phi^3 + (g6/120) phi^5 = 0 (full, radial)

definitions.frac: E(r < r_c, t) / E_total(t=0), r_c = 3 half-widths of the initial profile
definitions.omega: 2 pi / period between consecutive upward zero crossings of phi(0,t); early = median over t in [0,50], late = median over t in [450,500]
definitions.nonlinear_share_t0: int(-(g4/24) phi^4 + (g6/720) phi^6) / E_total at t=0
definitions.omega_settled: median core omega over t in [50,100] (after initial shedding)
definitions.death_time: first t > 50 with E(r<r_c) < 0.5 E(r<r_c, t=50); None if never
definitions.gamma_last200: -d ln E(r<r_c)/dt, line fit over [T-200, T] (1/m); only meaningful if alive_at_end
definitions.gamma_plateau: same fit over [50, death_time - 20] (or [50, T] if alive)
